sql.query: UPDATE tbl_event_milestones m SET m.isDefault=0,m.modifiedByUserId=:userId,m.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE m.tenantId=:tenantId AND :isDefault=1 AND m.id<>NULLIF(:id,0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:authorisedUser AND utr.tenantId=m.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)

INSERT INTO tbl_event_milestones (id,tenantId,milestoneName,milestoneGroup,timingCategory,sourceType,displayOrder,isActive,isDefault,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT NULLIF(:id,0),:tenantId,TRIM(:name),TRIM(:groupName),:timing,'manual',:displayOrder,CASE WHEN :isDefault=1 THEN 1 ELSE :isActive END,:isDefault2,:userId,:userId2 FROM DUAL WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(:name2),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:groupName2),'') IS NOT NULL AND :timing2 IN ('before_show','during_show','after_show') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:authorisedUser AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND utr.isActive=1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE milestoneName=VALUES(milestoneName),milestoneGroup=VALUES(milestoneGroup),timingCategory=VALUES(timingCategory),sourceType='manual',displayOrder=VALUES(displayOrder),isActive=VALUES(isActive),isDefault=VALUES(isDefault),modifiedByUserId=VALUES(modifiedByUserId),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
